Eyad Elfar — AI Engineer, based in Dubai, UAE. Currently at Baron & Cabot (since May 2025).

An AI/ML engineer with a Data Science foundation, strongest at taking models from training
into production: computer vision (detection, segmentation), LLMs, RAG, agentic and voice
systems, and the deployment work around them (Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, Docker, Google Cloud).

Career: Baron & Cabot, AI Engineer (2025–now) · MENRV.AI, Data Scientist (2024–2025) ·
NEOMI, AI Engineer, contract (2024–2025) · iSchool, AI Instructor (2023–2024) ·
e-finance, Data Analyst (2023).

Education: BSc Computer Science & AI, Helwan University (2020–2024), Excellent with Honors.
Languages: Arabic (native), English (professional).

Contact: the contact form at eyadelfar.github.io/#contact, linkedin.com/in/eyadelfar, or
github.com/eyadelfar.

chunks.title: Gamers' Mental-Health NLP Classifier
chunks.text:
Gamers' Mental-Health NLP Classifier
An NLP pipeline classifying mental-health risk signals from Reddit gaming posts with 94%
accuracy across 5,000+ posts. SHAP explainability surfaces which language patterns correlate
most with risk, making the model both precise and interpretable. Earned a Kaggle Bronze
Notebook Medal. Built with scikit-learn, NLTK, Transformers, and SHAP.

chunks.title: Cigarette-Butt Detection (YOLOv8)
chunks.text:
Cigarette-Butt Detection (YOLOv8)
Fine-tuned a pretrained YOLOv8 after benchmarking it against Faster R-CNN, building the
dataset in Roboflow and Kaggle, reaching 0.70+ mAP@50 for real-time detection. Shipped with
OpenCV, FastAPI, Docker, and dashboard integration. Built for a confidential organization;
won a Best Project medal.

chunks.title: One-Shot Attendance System (graduation thesis)
chunks.text:
One-Shot Attendance System (graduation thesis)
A real-time one-shot attendance system using YOLO, RetinaFace, and MTCNN for face detection,
recognition, counting, and duplicate removal. One-shot enrollment means a single photo per
person is enough — no retraining to add someone. Attendance records are stored in MySQL and
integrated through MS SSIS for live Power BI dashboard reporting.

chunks.title: Creativity Assessment System (NEOMI)
chunks.text:
Creativity Assessment System (NEOMI)
The scoring engine behind the NEOMI AR learning platform. A ResNet fine-tuned in PyTorch
extracts spatial features from abstract block compositions, and an LLM evaluator scores them
across six creativity dimensions — fluency, flexibility, elaboration, readability,
uniqueness, and mindfulness — reaching 92% alignment with educator benchmarks.

chunks.title: This chat assistant
chunks.text:
This chat assistant
The assistant answering you right now is itself a project. It runs an open-weights
Qwen3.5-0.8B model (Apache-2.0) quantized to GGUF and served by llama.cpp entirely on the
CPU of a free Hugging Face Space — no external inference API is called. Retrieval is
bge-small embeddings in an embedded LanceDB vector database, and speech-to-text is
faster-whisper, also running locally. Eyad built and hosts the whole stack.
